ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.Bypass_Lead_Validation), NOT(ISBLANK(Email)), OR( CONTAINS(LOWER(Email), "xxxx"), CONTAINS(LOWER(Email), "0000"), CONTAINS(LOWER(Email), "1111"), CONTAINS(LOWER(Email), "noemail"), CONTAINS(LOWER(Email), "no-email"), CONTAINS(LOWER(Email), "noreply"), CONTAINS(LOWER(Email), "no-reply"), CONTAINS(LOWER(Email), "unknown"), CONTAINS(LOWER(Email), "test@test"), CONTAINS(LOWER(Email), "none@"), CONTAINS(LOWER(Email), "na@"), REGEX(LOWER(Email), "^[x]+@."), REGEX(LOWER(Email), "^[0]+@.") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The email address entered appears to be a placeholder. Please enter the prospect's actual email address.
